visualCharacteristics.purpose: Related-article teasers in a horizontally scrolling slider
visualCharacteristics.layout: Square photo cards (300px mobile, 465px from 900px) with 25px radius, 20px gap; photo dimmed to 70% with white overlay copy; native horizontal scroll with snap and a teal progress track below
visualCharacteristics.typography: Tag 14px bold uppercase 2px tracking; title 20px mobile / 36px desktop, weight 400, clamped to 3 lines; outlined white Read More pill pinned to card bottom

contentPattern.structure: One row per card. Cell 1: article photo. Cell 2: category tag link (paragraph), title heading, Read More link to the article (last link; makes the whole card clickable)
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Six related-article cards: photo, category tag (About obesity / Obesity Care), title, Read More

usage: Related articles slider on the What is obesity page.
reuseGuidance: Use for a hand-picked list of 3+ article teasers that should scroll horizontally. Use related-articles when the list should come from the query index.
